claim: Theory in biology encompasses more than just replicating experimental results.
source: There is more to theory in biology than replicating the results of experiments
evidence: This is a direct assertion made by the author about the scope and nature of theoretical work in biology.

claim: The best theory papers help experimentalists identify which of their results might be general.
source: the best theory papers help experimentalists to identify which of their results might be general
evidence: This is a normative claim about what constitutes high-quality theoretical work, based on the author's perspective and experience.

claim: The best theory papers help experimentalists plan a path through the maze of all possible future experiments.
source: the best theory papers help experimentalists to identify which of their results might be general and to plan a path through the maze of all possible future experiments
evidence: This is a normative claim about the role of theory in guiding experimental design and prioritization.
